seo.title: DomEase | Homelife, eased.
seo.description: Plan meals, share the cleaning and keep one shopping list in Shillings, for everyone in the house. Built in Kampala, for Ugandan homes.

hero.chip: Built in Kampala, for Ugandan homes
hero.title: Run the house without running
hero.body: DomEase keeps the three things that actually run a household in one place. What you are eating, what needs cleaning, and what has to be bought, in Shillings, shared with everyone who lives there.
hero.note: Free to start. No card. Pay with mobile money when you upgrade.

glance.label: meal types planned for the whole week
home zones, each with its own checklist
shopping list the whole house shares

habits.title: One app, because they are one problem
habits.body: What you cook decides what you buy. What you clean decides what runs out. DomEase joins them up, so the list writes itself.

items.title: Meals
items.body: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks and pastries, planned Monday to Sunday. Every recipe scales to your household and comes with a full ingredient list.
points: Recipes for kids, adults and elders
Can't find it at the market? A swap is suggested
Swap the week's plan in one tap

items.title: Clean
items.body: Kitchen, bathroom, bedrooms and sitting room, each with its own tasks, set daily, weekly or monthly, and a streak to keep.
points: Edit the zones and tasks to fit your home
Running low on soap? It goes on the list

items.title: Shop
items.body: One combined list, filled from your meal plan and your cleaning zones, grouped the way you walk the market.
points: Low stock flagged before you run out
Add anything by hand, tick it off as you go

sharing.title: Everyone in the house sees the same thing
sharing.body: Add the people who live there and the person who helps. Each one sees the zones they are responsible for, so nobody has to be reminded and nobody has to nag.

points.text: Household members with their own view
House Help with zone access only
Gentle nudges, not notifications all day

sharing.note: Household sharing is part of Premium.

builtHere.title: Shillings, not dollars
builtHere.body: Prices in Ugandan Shillings. Mobile money at checkout. Groundnuts, posho, matoke and sukuma wiki in the recipes from day one, rather than bolted on later. House Help treated as a role in the household, because that is how households here actually work.
builtHere.payments: MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money

houseHelp.title: Hiring help? Compare candidates fairly
houseHelp.body: Eleven questions across four areas: fit and logistics, skills, reliability, and how they will get on with your household. DomEase turns the answers into a fit score and flags anything worth a second conversation.

pricing.title: Free to run the house. Premium to run it your way.
pricing.body: Everything you need for a full week of meals, cleaning and shopping is free. Premium adds the personal and the automatic.

free.name: Free
items: Full meal planner, all five meal types

premium.period: monthly or yearly, by mobile money
items: House Help: vetting questionnaire and guides

Diabetic and PCOS friendly meal ideas
Favourites, eating trends and budget insights
premium.disclaimer: Dietary suggestions are general guidance, not medical advice.

closing.title: Start with one week
closing.body: Plan seven days of meals, set up your zones, and see what the list looks like. It takes about ten minutes and costs nothing.
